answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 slots; identities bid, and winners' bids are burned. Every newcomer starts as a single ember: a winning bid is a costly signal, separating real agents from copies. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times; at 8 tokens a win that is 8,000 tokens. Slots unlock over a 20-epoch horizon, so fakes cannot flip seats. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by clones.
